MeteorLL.title: Critical Repair In Lower Levels
MeteorLL.description: The meteor shower breached a number of areas in the Lower Levels. We have closed down adjacent areas and started repairs on the breaches, but progress has been slow due to lack of supplies.

MeteorUL.title: Pool Repair In Upper Levels
MeteorUL.description: The Upper Levels Community pool was damaged during the meteor shower. It was due for renovation anyway. We are interested in buying a crate of engineering supplies to speed up the process.

MedShortageLL.title: Medical Supply For Lower Levels Charity Clinic
MedShortageLL.description: We are out of medical supplies. Shortages have left many without proper treatment. Any help would be greatly appreciated.

MedShortageUL.title: Medical Supply For Upper Levels General Hospital
MedShortageUL.description: We are experiencing delays in receiving critical medical supplies. While we still have stock, we are willing to pay a premium to ensure our reserves remain well-stocked.

MedShortageBM.title: Medical Supply For Black Market
MedShortageBM.description: With the ongoing shortage, we are buying up all the supply to drive up the price even higher! Get us the supply and we will pay you handsomely.

LLConstruction.title: Materials for Lower Level Construction
LLConstruction.description: A new housing block is under construction in the Lower Levels, but securing materials has been a challenge. We need supplies to keep the project moving forward.

BMConstruction.title: Construction Supplies
BMConstruction.description: The demand for construction materials is rising, and we intend to make sure we control the supply. Get us the supplies before the others do and we'll pay well.

LLSoupKitchen.title: Supplies for Lower Level Soup Kitchen
LLSoupKitchen.description: The recent events have left many in need. We can't pay much, but we will make sure to let everyone know of your kindness.

SecEvidence.title: Missing Evidence Locker
SecEvidence.description: A crate of important evidence has gone missing. We need it back ASAP, no questions asked. Deliver it quickly, and you'll be compensated accordingly.
SecEvidence.requesterName: Head of Security for Lower Levels

BMEvidence.title: Stolen Evidence Locker
BMEvidence.description: A recently stolen crate of evidence contains damaging information against my client. We are willing to pay a premium to secure it before it falls back into Security's hands or worse.

RevOxymore.title: Refreshment Request
RevOxymore.description: Need some refreshment for our friend's birthday party. It's last-minute.

RevScrapMetal.title: Scrap Metal Request
RevScrapMetal.description: We need scrap metal to build a new garden. The old one's decrepit.

RevSecCard.title: Housewarming Gift
RevSecCard.description: We need a housewarming gift for an upcoming friend's gathering.

RevPeat.title: Processed Meat Request
RevPeat.description: We are stocking up our garden for a picnic and need non-perishables. Processed meat is ideal.

ULRareItemRequest.title: Synaprest Injector
ULRareItemRequest.description: One of our clients has requested this. We will pay well for it.

ULRareItemCharityRequest.title: Roll of Toilet Paper
ULRareItemCharityRequest.description: We are collecting items for charity to help those in need in the Lower Levels. Any contribution would be greatly appreciated.

LowerWorkerStayAwakeRequest.title: Worker's Supplies
LowerWorkerStayAwakeRequest.description: Need something to survive those long shifts.

GeorgioToiletPaper.title: Toilet Paper for Georgio
GeorgioToiletPaper.description: Georgio needs toilet paper for his collection.

ButcherCleaver.title: Meat Cleaver
ButcherCleaver.description: Need a new cleaver. Old one is dull.

SawyerBeer.title: Beer for Janitor Crew
SawyerBeer.description: My crew's been grinding hard. Time to kick back. Get me some Red Imp Beers.

LunSnackBar.title: Li-Eat Snack Bars
LunSnackBar.description: My favorite snack bar is sold out everywhere. Get me a couple. I'll pay well.

CrowbarSawyer.title: Crowbar
CrowbarSawyer.description: Someone has been doing their own cleaning without our permission. We will make an example out of them.

EnergyDrinkJackson.title: Energy Drinks
EnergyDrinkJackson.description: Need some energy drinks to stay awake. Gotta finish my experiments!

LandlordSpecial.title: Landlord's Special
LandlordSpecial.description: One of my tenants keeps asking me to repair his door. Just get me some scrap metal and I'll see what I can do.

LandlordSpecial2.title: Landlord's Special 2
LandlordSpecial2.description: An annoying tenant keeps asking me to repair their ventilation. I guess I'll just increase the rent more next week.

LandlordSpecial3.title: Landlord's Special 3
LandlordSpecial3.description: One of my unit's street windows got broken. I'll just patch it up with some cloth.

LunRetirementParty.title: Retirement BBQ Party
LunRetirementParty.description: We are pitching in to get Officer Boucher a nice BBQ party for his retirement.

UpperCitizenPetMeat.title: Pet Food
UpperCitizenPetMeat.description: Acquire some real raw meat, fresh and unprocessed. Only the best for my pet.

MotherGalaxyBlend.title: Baby Food
MotherGalaxyBlend.description: I can't believe that Galaxy Blend is the only decent food nutritious enough for a baby around the Lower Levels. Help me get some.
